title: FR-4's first acceptance: buffered acidification of an owned compartment against its gradient, with an explicit K+ counterion, maintained fuel and a rapid-buffer closure
status: PROPOSED (drafted 15 November 2026 by the FR-4/FR-5 physics owner on branch fr45-physics). It stays PROPOSED until the integrated candidate runs; registration is the lead's

registration.no_judged_run_yet: No run of this world exists: the core's insertion points (stage reads, transporters, held rows, the face-free term) and this branch's laws are not yet wired
registration.launch: each judged unit through scripts/run_detached.sh, CPU 0 or as the lead assigns, --oom-first, cap 2G unless a development run measures more
registration.path: The lead registers it, from a clean snapshot of the integrated candidate, after this world's dt study and a rehearsal (the D150/MG0c path). It travels with fr45-physics's merge into integration-d172, since it depends on integration code, and reaches main with the single landing (the coordinator's ruling, 15 November)

rung: FR-4, acceptance 1 (numerical verification, D174's first claim kind; no living-cell claim)
question: Does the inner model, with rapid_proton_buffer@1, proton_atp_mass_action_positive@1 on maintained held fuel, proton_constant_field_leak@1 and @3's K+ constant-field route on the bounding patch, reproduce buffered acidification of a lumped compartment against its gradient, to an independent reference, at the world's declared step, with closed ledgers, and fail where its controls say it must?
engine_models: resolved_pump_tissue@3 (the inner model, with the core's stage-read, transporter, held-row and face-free-term insertion points)
rapid_proton_buffer@1 (a stage read; a declared reduced representation, D175)
proton_atp_mass_action_positive@1 (a transporter on the bounding patch)
maintained_held_rows@1 (the fuel rows; name as the core lands it)
cell_owned_compartments@1 (the compartment's identity; its refusal 4 lifted for K+-class routes under B7)
scope: Maintained fuel only (no depletion or recovery: that is the finite-fuel case's acceptance, D176 item 2). The K+ counterion only, at 5e-10 m/s (Cl- at lysosomal values and every ionic pore wait for the implicit patch). A lumped population of N = 1000 identical compartments as one node, declared; the single-compartment form is reported, not judged, in version 1 (a later version may judge it once species-scaled energy floors exist). Fixed volume (no water). The cytosol's pH within its fuel band (7.2 ± 0.05). Explicit ARS(2,2,2) at the world's declared dt; no implicit patch in this rung
driver: validation/compartment_ph/dt_study.py (--run once wired), with validation/compartment_ph/definitions.py fr4_world and parameters.World

theory_sources.closure: the rapid-buffer approximation; organelle-pH models carry a buffer capacity (Grabe and Oster 2001; Ishida et al. 2013; quoted in CLOSED_COMPARTMENT_DESIGN §3.2)
theory_sources.pump_form: processes/kinetic_pump.py's thermodynamically consistent form (cycles = capacity x saturation x (1 - exp(dG/RT)))
theory_sources.constant_field: Goldman 1943; Hodgkin and Katz 1949 (the flux, through electrochemistry.ghk_leak)
theory_sources.transformed_potentials: Alberty's transformed potentials at fixed pH and pMg (the older family's finite_atp_adp_pi_transformed@1)

references.independence: FR-4's references, written by a separate agent from the note's Appendix A and A.2 without reading engine code (the coordinator, 15 November); this protocol names their files when they land
references.kinetic: Appendix A.2's full protonation kinetics, for the closure's envelope check (convergence in k_on)
references.predictions: computed at run time from parameters.World, never typed: the held-fuel drive, the static head, the stall estimate, dt x G/C_b

world.parameters: parameters.World(): owner radius 10 um in a held bath (Na 145, K 5, Cl 110 mM, pH 7.4), impermeant plasma patch; lumped compartment of 1000 x 250 nm members; cytosol Na 10, K 140, Cl 10, B_c 50 mM at pK 7.2, pH 7.2, held ATP 3, ADP 0.3, Pi 3 mM, dG'0 -30.5 kJ/mol; lumen Na 10, K 140, Cl 10, B_L 40 mM at pK 6.0, pH 7.2; pump n 2 at 5000 cycles/s per member, K_H 1e-4 mM, K_ATP 0.1 mM; proton leak 6e-7 m/s; K+ 5e-10 m/s; 310 K; 900 s
world.declared_product_max_side: dt x G_K/C_b = 0.0253 (world-declared, not an engine bound; B7 enters the shared bound at its ordinary constant)
world.absent_rows: declared traces of 1e-9 mM (background on B_c, B_L, ATP, ADP, Pi; floor 1e-18 fmol)

predictions_at_drafting.control_stall: about 0.06 pH units (2.2e-5 fmol per member against a buffer of 3.4e-4 fmol per pH unit at pH 7.2)
predictions_at_drafting.steady_state: near pH 5 (pump against leak; the advisor's arithmetic), for orientation only
predictions_at_drafting.note: for orientation only: the judged run recomputes every prediction
predictions_at_drafting.early_pump_current_pA: about 0.44 (2,760 H+/s per member at the pump's saturation 0.276), carried by the K+ route at about 2.2 mV

rules.dt_study: S5's form, as D150's and MG0c's: per record, the step term |q(dt) - q(dt/2)| and the observed orders log2 of successive max-norm differences on the three finest rungs; the rule detects bias, not order
rules.state_error: at the declared 1 ms, the Richardson-estimated error of the lumen pH <= 1e-3 pH units and of V_b <= 1e-3 of its range
rules.reference: at 1 ms against the independent reference, within J4's budget of 1e-3 pH: the declared physical accuracy, the same as J3's. Basis: the references agent's measured floor on this world (about 5e-14 pH) shows the reference resolves that budget by about ten orders of magnitude; a multiple of the floor would sit far below the engine's own discretisation error at 1 ms, so J4 could never pass (the coordinator's corrected ruling, 15 November)
rules.envelope: the closure's estimated first-order lag behind the kinetic system, (rho/lambda)(beta/ln 10 - h)/(h ln 10), within 1e-3 pH at every stage of every buffered node (rapid_proton_buffer.lag_estimate_ph), counted and reported; any failure fails the part. Revised before registration: the FR-4 references' run 02 showed the earlier fixed ratio lambda >= 1e3 rho does not imply the budget (it passes from k_on 0.83 /mM/s, the budget only from about 1.28e4)
rules.ledgers: material per species within its declared floor at every record; charge within the capacitor tolerance; energy residual over flows <= 2e-3 at 1 ms (today's booking) and falling at second order down the ladder
rules.bands: the cytosol's pH within 7.2 ± 0.05 at every stage (the pump's domain refuses otherwise)
rules.judged_run: once, after registration, from a fresh clean execution snapshot of the integrated candidate (validation/source_snapshot.py)
rules.attempts: an attempt that ends by infrastructure before its verdict is written is not a verdict; a refusal by the engine is a verdict
rules.timing: each unit through scripts/run_detached.sh; one rung per unit; the 900 s world at 1 ms is about 0.9 CPU-hours by the charged-patch test's upper-bound cost

criteria.J1_admission: every rung admitted and run without refusal
criteria.J2_orders: observed orders of lumen pH, V_b, lumen K and pump cycles in [1.8, 2.2] on the three finest rungs
criteria.J4_reference: the reference rule at 1 ms: |pH_engine - pH_reference| <= 1e-3 at every record, with V_b, lumen K and pump cycles reported against the reference beside it
criteria.J5_envelope: the envelope rule (the state-dependent lag check)
criteria.J6_ledgers: the ledgers rule, and the bands rule
criteria.J7_controls: every control below caught as registered

controls.K1_no_counterion: the same world with P_K = 0 (World().control()): the lumen's pH falls by less than 0.1 units in 900 s, against more than 1 unit with the route; the references agent confirms the effect exceeds the declared budget (D176's G3)
controls.K2_planted_sign: the pump's moves flipped (+n per forward cycle) in a planted build: J4 must fail by more than its budget; a contract test already catches it at kernel level
controls.K3_closure_outside: the lumen buffer's k_on lowered to 1e-3 mM-1 s-1 (1 M-1 s-1) in the kinetic reference: the envelope check flags it at run time, and the closure departs from the kinetic reference beyond 1e-3 pH units

guards_of_record.species_only: a species-only guard world (D150's form) where the closure and the leak are the only energy flows, judged at rounding
guards_of_record.delta_g_per_law: a NumPy dG test per law per step (the kernels' contract tests, extended to the wired step)

reported_not_judged: the single-compartment form's ledger floors (C8 of the charged-patch analysis: H at about 1.6 free ions at pH 7.4)
compile time, memory and the cost per step
the steady-state pH (a consequence of generic parameters, not a claim)
what_it_does_not_show: Cl- counterions, ionic pores or the implicit patch
any living-cell or organelle-specific claim (the parameters are generic)
the closure's kinetic regime (it is a reduced representation inside its envelope)
disclosures: The declared step (1 ms, max-side 0.025) and the K+ permeability (5e-10 m/s) were chosen with the charged-patch test's runs 02-04 in view: explicit steps were refused by the energy booking above about 0.09 (log-mean) on worlds with no pump or buffer, so the 0.05 world-declared limit and its factor-of-two margin are extrapolations this protocol's dt study tests
The K+ counterion replaced Cl- after the same runs showed lysosomal Cl- needs 0.01-0.03 ms explicitly
The lumped population (N = 1000) was chosen after the floor arithmetic (CP4) showed a single compartment's pump energy sits within 6% of the absolute energy floor

The closure's envelope lost its dt clause after the advisor's check that §13's inside case would otherwise leave it near steady state; the 1e3 ratio and the 1e-3 pH budget were fixed before any comparison exists
The buffers' pK values, k_on and the pump's constants are generic declarations, not fits; no run of this world has been made
The dt ladder (2, 1, 0.5, 0.25 ms) was chosen with the 0.05 threshold in view, so that the coarsest rung sits at it

The envelope check was revised before any run of this world, after the FR-4 references' run 02 found that the fixed ratio admitted k_on = 1e3 with a 1.26e-2 pH lag; the revised check is the state-dependent lag estimate, with that case kept as a planted test

Absent rows: the world declares a 1e-9 mM trace (background 1e-9 mM, floor 1e-18 fmol) wherever a row does not apply, since absent rows are refused; the independent references use an exact 0 for the absent buffer. This is a declared difference: the closure's mask keys on the declared (node, row) pairs, so the traces are never live buffers, and their effect on the compared quantities is reported

runs.status: development (state against booking), not this world

outcome_rules: PASS when J1-J7 hold; otherwise the failing criteria are reported with their values and the world declares the finest rung that passes, without repair or retuning after the judged run
questions_answered: Registration: the lead, from a clean snapshot of the integrated candidate, after the dt study and a rehearsal; the protocol travels with the branch's merge into integration-d172 and reaches main with the single landing
The single-compartment form: reported, not judged, in version 1

J4's budget (corrected ruling): 1e-3 pH, the declared physical accuracy consistent with J3; the references' floor (about 5e-14 pH) shows the reference resolves it by many orders, as written in the reference rule
